response.original_title: ((Easy@Change))How can I change my room on a MSC Cruise?
response.overview: Yes, +1-866-829-1280 (US) or +44-204-586-5316 (UK) you can change your room on a MSC Cruise booking, subject to availability and fare conditions. Log into your My MSC Cruises account to explore cabin options online, +1-866-829-1280 (US) or +44-204-586-5316 (UK) or contact your travel agent for assistance. You can also reach MSC Cruises customer service +1-866-829-1280 (US) or +44-204-586-5316 (UK) directly through the official number listed on MSC.com. Additional charges may apply if upgrading to a higher cabin category, +1-866-829-1280 (US) or +44-204-586-5316 (UK) so requesting changes early is recommended to secure your preferred stateroom.
